text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-A-Ah, u-um, what should I do...!? My 
room is completely overflowing with all 
the presents everyone sent meee...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! That just proves how much your fans 
love you, Doto-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
What should we do? Should we wait to give 
you our present until after your room is 
cleaned up?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If you lose any more floor space, 
you're bound to trip and fall.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you for being so thoughtful, I'm 
so sorr— Wait, whaaat!? E-Even the two of 
you have presents for me~~!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Of course I did. ...A cat-shaped cushion. 
It seems you hit your head even while 
sleeping, after all. Why not keep it by 
your pillow?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fueeehhh~~...! Such a perfect gift...! 
Thank you so much~~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Is it... really okay for someone like 
me...? To be surrounded by such wonderful 
people... and treated so dearly...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Don't you get treated well because 
you've earned it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Giving your all to 
everything, never getting discouraged. And 
on top of that, being kind to everyone and 
welcoming anybody...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
See? How could you not love her! Doto-chan 
is our precious friend!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, don't cry...! Not out here in 
public, geez...!
